component.name: Huginn
component.summary: Private chat and file sharing, built for a controller

description.p: Huginn is an end-to-end encrypted chat and file sharing app for handhelds and the desktop. Every action works from a controller, text is typed with Steam's own keyboard, and the layout tightens up for a mouse and keyboard.

ul.li: Private messages with a fresh key for every message, over Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or the internet
Photos and voice messages, read receipts, nicknames and key change warnings
File sharing with Muninn and the LocalSend app, plus a QR code and PIN page for any phone
A chat lock, panic lock and encrypted backups
